text:
Maria (SecEng): incoming external assessment scheduled next week. vendor asked for RBAC list, KMS access, and audit log samples. can we get a short checklist?
Ethan (Infra): +1. I'll pull RBAC mapping and key ownership. timeline?
Maria (SecEng): window is 3/29-3/31. need evidence by EOD 3/30 so they can run tests.
Sam (SRE): for RBAC, we should export service-account bindings, role->member mapping, and any ephemeral roles used by assessors. I can run a query:
```
# list bindings
gcloud projects get-iam-policy redwood-prod --format=json > iam_bindings.json
```
Ethan (Infra): KMS: vendor needs to know who has decrypt/cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter and whether we rotate. I'll generate key ACLs + key rotation schedule.
Alice (Apps): FYI a few internal jobs use the app service account with decrypt. I'll add a quick inventory.
Oncall-DevOps: I can generate an audit export slice (1 week) and presign a download. Will need a pre-signed URL TTL. thoughts?
Maria (SecEng): 48h link is fine. include sample logs with KMS events and role assignment changes.
sec-bot: Reminder: run vulnerability tracker checklist -> /run vuln-checker --scope=external-assessment
Ethan (Infra): For evidence bundle, we'll include: RBAC CSV, KMS ACLs, audit export, a mapping doc (who owns keys), and remediation backlog link.
Maria (SecEng): remediation backlog—create JIRA epic and tag fixes with label `pt-2026-03`. Sam can you pre-seed with quick wins?
Sam (SRE): will add top 5 low-hanging items: overly broad roles, unused keys, missing audit levels.
PenTest Vendor: vendor note: we'll need a contact who can grant ephemeral role during test windows. please identify an on-call.
Oncall-DevOps: @Maria (SecEng) I'll be primary, Ethan backup.
Maria (SecEng): Good. Also, retest: prefer within 2 weeks after fix deploy. schedule preferred slots: 4/8-4/12.
Ethan (Infra): I'll block capacity.
Alice (Apps): tagging app teams — please freeze changes 24h before test window.
Maria (SecEng): thanks all. I'll compile checklist and post final in #eng-security tomorrow. :thumbsup:
